# DrainBar 0.3.2
Notifications are more complete, configurable, and reliable.
- Added Claude 5-hour and weekly reset notifications. - Added OpenAI 5-hour reset notifications when that window is available, plus weekly reset notifications. - Added support for multiple custom usage alerts with user-selected percentages. - Fixed notification permission status so it reflects the current macOS setting. - Notifications can now present banners, appear in Notification Center, and play a sound while DrainBar is active. - Fixed false session-reset alerts caused by one-second reset-time fluctuations. - Added a setting to disable yellow and red service-incident tinting on menu-bar provider icons.
